description: Loads .env files into Neovim's environment (vim.env) so environment variables are available to Lua scripts, LSP servers, and shell commands launched by Neovim.
author: ellisonleao
tagline: Load .env files into Neovim's environment variables

options.label: Auto-Load on Startup
options.description: Automatically load the .env file when Neovim starts. The file is searched upward from the current working directory. If false, use :Dotenv manually or call it from a graph.

options.label: Verbose Notifications
options.description: Show vim.notify messages when the .env file loads successfully or when it cannot be found. Useful for debugging environment setup issues.

options.label: Env File Name
options.description: Filename to search for when loading environment variables. The plugin searches upward from the current working directory, so you can use project-root .env files from any subdirectory.

options.label: Auto-Load Trigger Event
options.description: Neovim autocmd event that triggers the auto-load. Only active when Auto-Load on Startup is enabled. Common choices: VimEnter (after Neovim fully starts), BufEnter (on every buffer), BufRead (when reading a file).

functions.name: load_dotenv
functions.label: Load .env File
functions.description: Load a .env file into vim.env. If no path is given, searches upward from the current working directory for the configured file name.
functions.whatItDoes: Reads a .env file and sets each KEY=VALUE pair as a Neovim environment variable (vim.env.KEY), making them available to Lua and to any process Neovim spawns.

params.name: path
params.description: Absolute or relative path to the .env file. Leave empty to search upward from cwd.

functions.name: get_env_var
functions.label: Get Environment Variable
functions.description: Print the current value of an environment variable loaded by dotenv.nvim. Variable name is case-insensitive (automatically uppercased).
functions.whatItDoes: Looks up a key in vim.env and prints it to the Neovim command line. Useful for verifying that a .env file loaded correctly.

params.name: var_name
params.description: The environment variable name to look up (e.g., DATABASE_URL). Case-insensitive.

functionTemplates.label: Load .env from Neovim Config Dir
functionTemplates.shortDescription: Load a .env file located in your Neovim config directory (~/.config/nvim/.env)
functionTemplates.whatItDoes: Loads environment variables from a .env file stored alongside your Neovim configuration.

exCommands.name: Dotenv
exCommands.description: Load a .env file into Neovim's environment. With no argument, searches upward from the current working directory for the configured file name (default: .env). With a path argument, loads that specific file.

params.name: path
params.description: Optional path to a .env file. If omitted, searches upward from the current working directory.

exCommands.name: DotenvGet
exCommands.description: Print the current value of an environment variable that was loaded by dotenv.nvim. The variable name is automatically converted to uppercase.

params.name: var
params.description: Environment variable name to look up (e.g., DATABASE_URL, API_KEY). Case-insensitive.
